text:
emma: Quick sync request 3: we need a concise launch artifact that ties routing tiers to launch gates, migration constraints, and a simple pricing note for sales. Can someone draft a v0 one-pager?

rahul: Happy to. Proposal: define three tiers (shared-shard, geo-isolate, tenant-island) and for each list: required contract (if any), SLOs (p50/p95/p99), kv semantics (local/peeking/none), allowed egress, and rollback escape hatch.

sofia: Ops concerns: cross-region peeking reduces cold starts but increases egress and complicates KV coherence. If we allow peeking for geo-isolate, require an opt-in flag + explicit cost multiplier in the UI. Also need a runbook for slow-link scenarios.

tom: Sales needs a single-line demo toggle and a sample % uplift per tier. Even a rough range (+25% / +60% / +150%) helps deal cycles. Also include a short customer-facing blurb about predictable tail latency.

rahul: For launch gates recommend: (1) policy DSL + unit tests, (2) telemetry dashboard + alert thresholds, (3) pilot tenants (5), (4) migration playbook w/ soft-evict <2hr, (5) finance-approved cost multipliers.

sofia: Add mandatory chaos tests for any tier that permits cross-region peeking: slow-link simulation + partial region outage. Rollback path must return traffic to a regional-compatible variant within 30 minutes. Tenant-island should require Reserved Capacity sign-up before cutover.

emma: I'll produce the one-pager skeleton. Keep DSL tiny for v1. Example snippet we can show to customers: 

```
policy: {
  tier: "geo-isolate",
  affinity: "soft",
  kv_cache: "region-local",
  peeking: "opt-in",
  fallback: "region-compat-quant",
  sla_p99_ms: 120
}
```

rahul: Nice. Also include a short table mapping common model families to recommended default tiers (e.g., efficient-embed -> shared-shard, large-chat -> geo-isolate / tenant-island). That reduces decision friction.

tom: Please include the demo toggle copy: "Strong Isolation 1 1 We provision dedicated compute and guarantee data residency. Price uplift: +30-120% depending on throughput."

infra-bot: deploy-bot: policy-canary v4 rolled out to canary-7 (link: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/pcv4-7).

emma: Action items: emma -> one-pager + example DSL by Mon EOD; rahul -> mapping table + fallback contracts; sofia -> migration runbook template + chaos checklist; tom -> demo copy + pricing ranges. Reconvene Wed 9am to sign off.

sofia: Small ask: make the default conservative (no peeking) and require explicit opt-in; reduces surprise ops costs.

emma: Agreed. v1 default = region-local only. Opt-in peeking documented with expected p99 delta and cost multiplier.

rahul: I'll sketch the DSL validator tests so CI can block policy merges that violate constraints.

emma: Great team. Keeping the v1 surface small and explicit should make launch smooth.
